title: Hoffman
summary: Hoffman is a high-level member of the Organization who served under Mr. Wilder and previously under the Professor himself. He may be old, Hoffman is an experienced Seeker with a strong resoluteness and sets the example for younger members of the Organization to follow.

sections.heading: History
sections.text:
Hoffman was a high ranking official and loyal follower of the Professor. After the Professor's defeat, he became a joined the team of Mr. Mr. Wilder and supported him in his campaign to become the new leader of the Organization. [Doorway to Huntik]

Hoffman was with Mr. Wilder and Stack at the South American Forest in Peru. He fought Dante Vale outside the waterfall cave that hid the Nexus but retreated with Mr. Wilder
when Myrmidon was defeated. [Doorway to Huntik]

At Tower of Nostradamus, Hoffman defeated the three Huntik operatives stationed there, first Billie and Peter, and right after that Annette while she was dialing for help. When Dante's team arrived, Hoffman fought against Lok Lambert and Sophie Casterwill but was thrown out of the tower by the enchanted Sentry Triclops Titans. [The Tower of Nostradamus]

Hoffman then was sent to the Chu Goku Mount, Japan, with Eathon the dog to find the Amulet of Divine Mirror Kagami. He took the Amulet to Avalon and fought against Dante, who was turned to stone when Kagami's ability reflected the Stonegaze ability of King Basilisk. When Zhalia Moon reversed the ability and returned Dante to normal, Hoffman retreated with Stack. [Knight of the Willblade]

Hoffman was with Mr. Wilder's team when Lok, Sophie and Cherit were captured. He left with Mr. Wilder, leaving Stack and the remaining team with the mission of escorting Lok, Sophie and Cherit to Organization HQ. [Chasing Void]

Hoffman, alongside Mr. Wilder and Stack, ambushed the Huntik team in Klaus' laboratory. He fought against Lok and Sophie, but was defeated through the aid of Cherit before the Organization was ambushed by the Blood Spiral. [The Blood Spiral]

He and Mr. Wilder observed Stack attempting to infiltrate the Blood Spiral on Medusa Island. When Dante's team arrived, Hoffman summoned Myrmidon to fight alongside a Suit's Venomaster against Dante's Caliban. Meanwhile, Hoffman fought against Sophie and Sabriel but, upon defeat, retreated with Mr. Wilder, leaving Stack behind. [Zhalia's Mission]

At the vault of Hernán Cortés, Hoffman and Mr. Wilder set few new traps for Dante and his team, capturing Den Fears in a Trapcage spell. Hoffman fought Den, Lok, and Sophie, but retreated when Dante obtained the Ring of Umbra the Shadow Jaguar, trapping the Huntik Foundation in the cave with Conquistador. [The Power of Umbra]

When the Huntik team went looking for Rassimov's secret files in the Professor's castle, Hoffman and Mr. Wilder were at that base. Hoffman and Eathon the dog fought against Dante and Grier, but he was eventually subdued and defeated. Afterwards, Hoffman was left to guard the castle when Grier took Mr. Wilder hostage and took control of the Organization. [An Ally from the Organization]

sections.heading: Personality
sections.text:
As a loyal member of the Organization, Hoffman took orders from his superiors without hesitation. Due to this loyalty, he was well-liked by the Professor and thoroughly despised traitors. [Doorway to Huntik] Shunning cowardice, he values resolution and determination. [Knight of the Willblade] Due to his strong resolve, Hoffman can be stubborn when it comes to him making up his mind. [An Ally from the Organization] However, unlike the lower Suits, Hoffman can weigh the odds of a confrontation and knows when it is more rational to avoid the direct approach. [Knight of the Willblade] He also is not a believer in superstition. [The Tower of Nostradamus] Hoffman possesses knowledge of history. [The Power of Umbra] 

Hoffman has an extreme loyalty and respect for the Professor as shown when he took custody of Eathon the dog and when he tried to stop the Huntik Foundation from entering the Professor's castle. [Knight of the Willblade] [An Ally from the Organization] He would not take any disresepct that the Professor needed lies to control anyone, defending him stating that the man had absolute power. [Chasing Void]

sections.heading: Abilities
sections.wikitext:
[[File:S2E35_Hoffman_invokes_Myrmidon.png|thumb|200px|Hoffman invokes [[Myrmidon]]]]
Despite being old, Hoffman is a formidable Seeker. In addition to basic Organization abilities, Hoffman is capable of using the [[Earthband]] and [[Rockforce]] spells. He possesses a roster of standard issue Organization Titans, joined by the more unique [[Doberman]] and [[Myrmidon]]. He also seems to be quite skillful and strong as he was able to hold his own even against a powerful [[Seeker]] like [[Dante Vale]]. {{source|An Ally from the Organization}}

Despite being old, Hoffman is a formidable Seeker. In addition to basic Organization abilities, Hoffman is capable of using the Earthband and Rockforce spells.
